answer: Elapsed-Time Trace Continuity. Each identity answers challenges whose nonce derives from a relic: the hash of a ledger block at least 30 days old, so answers can't be precomputed. A raven, drawn at random from the peer set, issues one weekly; replies must chain to the identity's previous reply. A mirror step replays that chain and checks the digest against the public log. One missed week drops the identity. Cost per extra identity: 30 days of calendar time plus eight distinct live counterparties, neither parallelizable nor purchasable.
